user_confirmation: 确认并授权新的单次复测
scope: One new raised-wheel physical cable-loss attempt after the prior attempt ended without cable removal. Target-local capture pauses before motion until the operator places a hand on the RK3588 CAN connector and types ARMED. Then right wheel +5 rpm, left wheel zero, fixed application 200 ms lead and existing 8 s maximum external-loss window. On DISCONNECT NOW remove only the RK3588 CAN branch, observe normal stop, reconnect about 3 s later, type RECONNECTED, and verify can0 remains DOWN with no host request more than 250 ms after interface-down observation. Target candump and silent JCAN 207F346D5650; no automatic retry, persistent drive write, kernel/SDK change, JCAN TX, or automatic can0 recovery.
